fun_facts: KC Concepcion was born in Charlotte, North Carolina.
His college stops included NC State and Texas A&M.
KC Concepcion won the 2025 Paul Hornung Award, which recognizes college football’s most versatile player.
In his Texas A&M debut, he caught a touchdown pass and returned a punt for a touchdown. He was the first Aggies player to do both in one game since Christian Kirk in 2017.

## KC Concepcion with a spectacular touchdown vs. UTSA Roadrunners

* * *

By AP

Aug 31, 2025, 03:50 pm

Facebook Facebook Messenger Twitter Email

COLLEGE STATION, Texas -- — [Marcel Reed](http://www.espn.com/college-football/player/_/id/4870971/marcel-reed) threw for a career-high four touchdowns and [KC Concepcion](http://www.espn.com/college-football/player/_/id/4870653/kc-concepcion) had a TD reception and returned a punt for another score in his Texas A&M debut as the 19th-ranked Aggies rolled to a season-opening 42-24 win over UTSA on Saturday night.

[Robert Henry Jr](http://www.espn.com/college-football/player/_/id/5151317/robert-henry-jr) .’s 75-yard touchdown run on the first play of the second half cut Texas A&M's lead to 21-17.
